Easy Peasy Strawberry Dessert
By: Diethood
Published: Thursday, May 12, 2011 - 7:08am

Ingredients




4 ounces (half of 8 oz. package) Cream Cheese, softened
1/2 cup Strawberry Jam
1 cup Whipped Topping
1 cup sliced strawberries, divided

Preparation

1 In the bowl of your mixer, mix together the cream cheese and the jam until well blended, about a minute or so. 2 Gently stir in the whipped topping. 3 In four ramekins spoon in half of the sliced strawberries. 4 Pour the cream cheese mixture over the strawberries. 5 Top with remaining strawberries. 6 Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use.

About


Creamy dessert made with a sweet cream cheese mixture and fresh strawberries.
